facts.fact: Warrior levels slowly alone: almost no self-healing and no real crowd control, and higher-level mobs are hard to beat solo.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Warrior shines in dungeons and groups thanks to strong cleave; grouping with a healer speeds leveling a lot.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Your weapon decides nearly all of your damage while leveling, so replace it whenever a better one shows up.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Run dungeons while leveling: they give the weapon upgrades a Warrior needs to keep up with mobs.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Trainer at level 1 teaches Battle Shout and Heroic Strike; keep Battle Shout active the whole time.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Level 4 brings Rend and Charge; level 6 adds Thunder Clap for groups of enemies.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Hamstring arrives at 8 and slows a target, handy for kiting or stopping runners.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: At 10 you get Bloodrage, and the starting-zone class quest gives Defensive Stance, Taunt and Sunder Armor.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Level 12 adds Overpower and Shield Bash; level 14 adds Revenge, Demoralizing Shout and Tactical Mastery.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Level 20 is a big step: Victory Rush (small heal), Cleave, Retaliation, Slam, Dual Wield and Polearms.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Execute is learned at 24, Shield Wall at 28 and Whirlwind at 36.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: At 30 a class quest on Fray Island near Ratchet unlocks Berserker Stance and Intercept.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: The Whirlwind Axe quest in Alterac Mountains starts around 30 but is very hard at that level; buy its materials or bring a stronger friend.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Level 40 unlocks Plate armor, Apprentice Riding and a second talent spec; Recklessness comes at 50.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Before 30 talents do not matter much: spend spare Rage on Heroic Strike, keep Rend up and open with Charge.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: For solo leveling a shield Protection build is safest: Revenge, Rend and Thunder Clap on cooldown handle packs.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: For group leveling Arms with a slow two-hander works well; Sweeping Strikes adds cleave and Mortal Strike is the finisher talent.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Rage gain depends on weapon speed, not damage; don't waste Rage and switch stances when a fight needs it (switching costs Rage).
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Defensive Stance lowers damage taken and raises threat; Berserker raises crit but you take more damage; Battle is neutral.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Use Intimidating Shout, Retaliation and Shield Wall freely on big pulls; they are what makes fast Warrior leveling safe.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Stat order while leveling: weapon DPS first, then Strength/Attack Power, Stamina, Agility and Armor.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Warriors need no reagents; eat cooked food for its XP buff and keep stat elixirs for hard fights.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Mining + Blacksmithing suits Warrior: Blacksmithing makes Weapon Stones for flat extra damage.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Skinning gives early gold toward the level 40 mount; First Aid bandages help in rough fights.
facts.title: Method: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide

facts.fact: Cooking is useful in Forever because food gives XP and professions grant camp buffs.
facts.title: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Forever Warrior Leveling Guide
